summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for incoming automated reviews (CodeRabbit, Copilot) and auto-resolve them as they arrive, then capture staging performance baselines before a vault migration deploys.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads across 4 Copilot rounds were resolved with real fixes committed; staging perf baselines were captured via Playwright; a session-restore race condition (root cause of CI failures) was diagnosed, fixed in two layers, and merged as PR #350.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed — functions now return Uint8Array directly; docs referencing VaultBlobV2 were stale
Old staging code never published vault key blob to IPNS during wallet-created vault flows — IPNS resolve always returned 404 on staging
Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time (9-45s); cipher-box vault-critical path is only ~700-1400ms
The Axios 401 interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts already deduplicates refresh on 401 responses, but direct authApi.refresh() calls in the session restore effect were NOT deduplicated
E2E tests use @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for wallet injection — real secp256k1 signing, not mocks
DB schema has unique constraint UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns on the folder_ipns table
TEE republishes IPNS records every 3h, making IPNS record expiry a non-issue for vault key blobs
GSD todos live in .planning/todos/pending/ with a specific markdown format

code.finding: Broad try/catch around getVault() meant any IPFS 404 (missing CID) would be misclassified as a new-user state and trigger vault re-initialization
After PR #349, existing vault login tries to resolve vault key IPNS name; if IPNS record not found, throws 'Vault key IPNS name not found' which cascades to Core Kit logout
Session restore effect calls initializeOrLoadVault() immediately after setAccessToken() — Zustand state update may not be reflected in Axios interceptor before the vault API call fires
authApi.refresh() had no deduplication — multiple concurrent React effect cycles on page reload triggered 6 parallel refresh calls, 2 of which returned 401
directRootIpnsName was actually the vault key IPNS name but was being used for root folder traversal — real bug causing incorrect folder resolution in recovery flow
Used slice() (copies buffer) instead of subarray() (zero-copy view) — switched to subarray()
Sequence-0 conflict on vault init was warning-and-continuing; changed to abort with error to prevent partial state

workflow: CronCreate with recurring:true enables persistent 5-minute PR monitoring loops; jobs auto-expire after 7 days
Outside-diff-range review comments don't appear as unresolved GraphQL reviewThreads — need to check review bodies separately
Playwright network monitoring via page.on('request'/'response') is reliable across navigations; fetch interception via window.fetch override does not survive page navigations
Module-level shared Promise pattern (let p: Promise|null = null; if(p) return p; p = work().finally(()=>p=null)) is the correct deduplication pattern for concurrent async calls in React hooks
markdownlint enforces specific rules (no trailing spaces, blank lines around headings, list formatting) that must be satisfied for commits to pass pre-commit hooks

friction: GitHub API timed out on one cron check — transient, retried on next tick
Outside-diff-range Copilot comments were not caught by the GraphQL unresolved-thread query, requiring manual intervention from the user to flag them
Playwright MCP sandbox doesn't support Node module imports (require/dynamic import of local packages) — had to write standalone .mjs scripts run via Bash instead
Web3Auth SIWE on staging uses real OTP verification, blocking interactive wallet login via Playwright MCP; required injecting a mock wallet provider before page load
Core Kit tKey shares don't persist across Playwright browser contexts, making true session-restore measurement (tab close + reopen) not directly testable
Staging DB was wiped, so no existing vault data was available for IPNS resolve latency measurement — had to create a vault during the perf run
Auth/refresh race condition caused 6 concurrent refresh calls on reload, 2 returning 401, which was surfacing as intermittent test failures before root cause was identified
open_items: Post-deploy re-measurement: run tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs against staging after PR #349 deploys to get real vault key IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch latencies for comparison
True session restore baseline (Core Kit cached session across tab close/reopen) was not measured — mock wallet context doesn't persist tKey shares
PR #350 (session restore race condition fixes) needs review and merge; CI should confirm the duplicate vault init error is resolved
